challengesData.heading:
Where Townhalls 
 Lose the Company
challengesData.subhead: A townhall is often the only time every employee hears leadership at once. When remote staff can't hear or can't ask, the message lands with half the company.

problem.title: Remote Staff Hear an Echo
problem.text: A laptop near a speaker picks up the room. Viewers get hollow sound and miss half of every sentence.

solution.title: A Dedicated Stream Mix
solution.text: Every mic feeds the stream directly, mixed for headphones and laptop speakers, separate from the room.

problem.title: Questions Never Reach the Stage
problem.text: One roaming mic, a slow walk, a hand that stays down. Remote questions sit unread in a chat window.

solution.title: Q&A Built In, Room and Remote
solution.text: Aisle mics for the room, a moderated queue for remote staff, both visible to the host on stage.

problem.title: Setup Takes the Whole Morning
problem.text: Every quarter, the cafeteria becomes a venue with hired kit and cables taped across the floor.

solution.title: A Permanent System, One Touch
solution.text: Installed cameras, mics and screens. Your comms team picks "Townhall" and the space is ready.

faqHeaderData.heading:
Common Questions on 
 Townhall AV Solutions

faqData.question: How long does a townhall AV project take?
faqData.answer: It depends on the space, the number of connected offices and equipment lead times. Survey and design come first and move at the pace of drawing approvals. We give you a programme after the survey [confirm typical range].

faqData.question: Can our cafeteria or atrium double as the townhall space?
faqData.answer: Often, yes. We measure the acoustics and sightlines first. Hard, open spaces usually need distributed speakers and careful mic placement, and the system switches between everyday use and townhall mode from one panel.

faqData.question: Can we reuse our existing video conferencing equipment?
faqData.answer: Sometimes, for displays and platform licences. Meeting-room cameras and speakerphones are rarely built for a large audience. The survey shows what can stay before your budget is set.

faqData.question: Which streaming platforms do you work with?
faqData.answer: We design around the platform your company already licenses, most often Microsoft Teams or Zoom [confirm full list of supported platforms]. The production feed connects to it, so staff join the way they join any other meeting.

faqData.question: How many remote employees can watch at once?
faqData.answer: That limit is set by your platform and licence tier, and it changes over time. We check your current limits during design and size the stream, recording and office bandwidth to your real headcount.

faqData.question: Can other offices ask questions live?
faqData.answer: Yes. Connected offices can speak through their own room systems, and individual staff can submit questions to a moderated queue that the host sees on the confidence monitor. Echo cancellation keeps remote voices clean in the room and on the stream.

faqData.question: Is the stream kept internal?
faqData.answer: It runs on your company platform under your existing sign-in and access rules, and the AV system sits on its own secured network segment. We agree the settings with your IT and security teams before go-live.

faqData.question: Do we need a technician for every townhall?
faqData.answer: Not for standard formats. Your comms team runs them from preset modes after training. Larger productions with several remote guests or video playback may still benefit from an operator [confirm event-day operator service].

faqData.question: Do you support Arabic and English interpretation?
faqData.answer: We design the infrastructure for it: booth positions, cabling and distribution for receivers in the room, plus a separate audio channel for the stream where your platform supports it [confirm scope of interpretation systems offered].

faqData.question: Who supports the system after handover?
faqData.answer: Your comms and IT teams handle daily operation with the training and documentation we provide. If you want ongoing cover, an optional AV AMC adds remote monitoring, scheduled preventive visits and SLA-backed response. It is not required, and the handover pack lets your team or any integrator support the system without it.
